description: This file defines a PHP interface 'Report' within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Report. The interface specifies methods for retrieving header definitions, filter definitions, and report data for a reporting system in an HR management context.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the header definition for the report, providing structure for table headers.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns the filter definition for the report, specifying how filters can be applied.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the report data based on provided filter parameters.
